title: Cross-room carry Stage A-fix3: measured door-gap acceptance, own-RGB zone-edge declaration check, alignment kept

policy.base: visgoal candidate C build c390105c2 (vendored byte copy)
policy.overrides: vgs_fix.py + paint_area_filter.py (v2 filter); vendored bytes unchanged

prior_results.A: 1/16 GT door, 9/16 false gap claims, declared 8/16 (r4 arrival), found 4/16 (3 beam false)
prior_results.B: 0/16 GT door, box held 16/16, held-box occlusion cause
prior_results.fix_v1: 0/16 GT door, found 0, gap 6 claims/264 reject/6 false confirm, 4/16 approach stalls
prior_results.fix_v2: 1/16 GT door (e02 t=58.0), found 1, declared 1, GT-inside 0 (margin -0.0162 m), gap 606 reject/0 confirm, paint 133 accepted true zone / 548 rejected

gap_v3.rule: accept a side-wall gap only if (a) side wall tracked >=12 ticks, (b) ahead cone |bearing|<=20 deg and range<=1.0 m has <=10 wall points, (c) a jamb wall face exists on the followed side in 20-110 deg (right wall; mirrored for left) within 1.3 m

calibration_from_recorded_stage_A_gap_ev.note: wall points recomputed offline from the recorded frames and trace servo poses; no gate outcome used
calibration_from_recorded_stage_A_gap_ev.conclusion: all 9 recorded gap claims are rejected by this rule (dense front cone on e03/e10/e14; no jamb on the rest), while the authored doorway keeps the ahead cone empty and shows the far jamb

zone_edge.rule: before keeping an arrival declaration, require the destination paint bbox bottom to reach >=0.98 of the frame height (bottom 2% band); otherwise retract and creep forward for at most 30 ticks, then force-declare with an event
zone_edge.calibration: the only recorded declaration outside zone B (fix v2 e02 t=79.9, GT margin -0.0162 m) had paint bbox bottom 461/480 = 0.960
zone_edge.basis: own RGB only; no world pose; declared-stop margin is checked against eval-only GT afterwards

v3_changes.alignment: v1 door-align override kept (two-jamb lateral estimate, tolerance 0.02 m); exercised only if a real gap is accepted

fix_metrics.zone_edge_ok_n: declarations kept with paint in the bottom band
fix_metrics.zone_edge_forced_n: forced declarations after the retract budget

success_threshold: none (measurement gate). Compare against Stage A and fix v2: GT crossing, declared, GT-inside, margin, lateral/jamb, false gap claims, approach stalls. Any claim is checked against the raw.
expected_wall: about 2.5-3.0 h for 16 x 180 Sim s (v2: 8732.72 s)
